nodes.description: WithdrawManager.exits: mapping(uint256 => PlasmaExit) storing exit state, inputs and exit owner
WithdrawManager.ownerExits: mapping(bytes32 => uint256) guarding one MoreVP exit per token/owner
WithdrawManager.exitsQueues: mapping(address => address) of token to PriorityQueue
WithdrawManager.exitNft: ExitNFT representing ownership of exits
WithdrawManager.HALF_EXIT_PERIOD: challenge period, owner updatable
WithdrawManager.isKnownExit: mapping(uint128 => bool) duplicate exit guard
Registry trusted reference cached in WithdrawManager/DepositManager storage
RootChain reference used for deposit id and header block reads
WithdrawManager.ON_FINALIZE_GAS_LIMIT: gas bound for processExits loop
WithdrawManager.exitWindow public configuration value
DepositManager.deposits: mapping(uint256 => DepositBlock) deposit hash and timestamp
DepositManager.maxErc20Deposit: cap on single ERC20 deposit
PriorityQueue.heapList: heap array holding (priority,value) packed exits
PriorityQueue.currentSize: number of heap elements
Ownable._owner: privileged owner account used by onlyOwner
ERC20._balances: token balance bookkeeping
StateSender.counter: monotonically increasing state sync id
StateSender.registrations: mapping(address => address) receiver to sender
RootChainStorage._nextHeaderBlock: next header block id, bumped by MAX_DEPOSITS
RootChainStorage.headerBlocks: mapping(uint256 => HeaderBlock)
WithdrawManager.processExits(address _token): loops over queue, burns exit NFT and makes an arbitrary external call to the exit predicate
WithdrawManager.challengeExit: verifies deprecation through an arbitrary predicate, burns the exit NFT and sends the bond to msg.sender
WithdrawManager.addExitToQueue: predicate-authorized external entry to create an exit
WithdrawManager._addExitToQueue: writes exits mapping, duplicates guard, queue insert and NFT mint
WithdrawManager.addInput: predicate-authorized addition of a UTXO input to an exit
WithdrawManager._addInput: stores Input struct and emits ExitUpdated
WithdrawManager.verifyInclusion: verifies receipt/tx merkle patricia proofs against a checkpoint
WithdrawManager.processExitsBatch: loops processExits over many tokens
WithdrawManager.createExitQueue: registry-only deployment of a new PriorityQueue
WithdrawManager.getExitableAt: computes exitable timestamp from createdAt and now
WithdrawManager.checkBlockMembershipInCheckpoint: merkle membership check against rootChain header block
WithdrawManager.encodeExit: abi encodes exit data for predicate verification
DepositManager.depositBulk: loops user supplied token arrays performing external transferFrom calls
DepositManager.depositERC20ForUser: caps amount and pulls ERC20 tokens from msg.sender
DepositManager.depositEther: wraps msg.value into WETH and creates a deposit block
DepositManager.onERC721Received: ERC721 safe transfer callback that credits a deposit for msg.sender token
DepositManager.tokenFallback: ERC223 style callback that credits a deposit for msg.sender token
DepositManager._safeCreateDepositBlock: lock and token-mapping checked deposit creation
DepositManager._createDepositBlock: writes deposit hash with now and calls stateSender.syncState
DepositManager.transferAssets: predicate-authorized transfer of ERC20/ERC721/WETH out of the deposit manager
DepositManager.updateChildChainAndStateSender: caches registry addresses
StateSender.syncState: registered-only state sync emitting StateSynced
StateSender.register: owner-or-registered authorization to set registrations
PriorityQueue.insert: onlyOwner heap push
PriorityQueue.delMin: onlyOwner heap pop
PriorityQueue._percUp: heap bubble up
PriorityQueue._percDown: heap bubble down
RootChain.submitCheckpoint: decodes checkpoint data, builds header block and calls stakeManager.checkSignatures
RootChain.updateDepositId: onlyDepositManager counter bump for deposit ids
Registry.mapToken: onlyGovernance root/child token mapping and exit queue creation
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner privileged ownership change
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner sets owner to zero address
PredicateUtils.onFinalizeExit: onlyWithdrawManager hook that decodes exit data and calls depositManager.transferAssets
DepositManager.updateMaxErc20Deposit: onlyGovernance cap update
DepositManager.depositERC721ForUser: pulls an NFT from msg.sender
WithdrawManager.updateExitPeriod: onlyOwner mutation of HALF_EXIT_PERIOD
DepositManager fallback payable function forwarding to depositEther
msg.sender: attacker controlled caller used for bond payout, predicate identity and ownership checks
block.timestamp/now: used for exitable-at math and deposit timestamps
processExits: currentExit.predicate.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("onFinalizeExit(bytes)",...)) external call to an arbitrary predicate
challengeExit: msg.sender.send(BOND_AMOUNT) raw ETH transfer to an untrusted caller
processExits: address(uint160(exitor)).send(BOND_AMOUNT) raw ETH transfer to the exit owner
ExitNFT.burn(exitId): external call back into the ExitNFT token contract
_createDepositBlock: stateSender.syncState(childChain, ...) external call to a registry supplied contract
IERC20(_token).transferFrom(...) external call for user supplied token addresses
IERC721(_token).transferFrom(...) external NFT transfer that can trigger receiver callbacks
rootChain.updateDepositId(...) external call to the RootChain contract
transferAssets: IERC20(_token).transfer(_user, _amountOrNFTId) external token transfer to an arbitrary user
transferAssets: WETH(_token).withdraw(_amountOrNFTId, _user) external WETH withdraw to a user supplied address
createExitQueue: address(new PriorityQueue()) deploys an Ownable queue contract
submitCheckpoint: stakeManager.checkSignatures(...) external validator signature verification
challengeExit: IPredicate(adjudicatorPredicate).verifyDeprecation(...) external call to a caller supplied predicate
processExits: PriorityQueue(exitsQueues[_token]).delMin() external call

edges.reason: processExits performs an external low-level call currentExit.predicate.call(onFinalizeExit) to an exit predicate address controlled by exit data
the arbitrary predicate invoked by processExits can reenter processExits/challengeExit before the loop finishes finalizing exits
the external predicate call dispatches into PredicateUtils.onFinalizeExit
processExits burns the exit NFT via the ExitNFT token contract which performs an external call
challengeExit burns the exit NFT through the external ExitNFT contract before paying out the bond
challengeExit sends ETH to msg.sender with send() after state changes, allowing untrusted caller code to run
an untrusted challenger contract receiving the bond can reenter challengeExit before the exit is fully cancelled
challengeExit calls verifyDeprecation on an adjudicatorPredicate address supplied by the caller
the caller supplied adjudicator predicate can call back into WithdrawManager during challengeExit
onFinalizeExit calls depositManager.transferAssets while WithdrawManager is finalizing an exit
transferAssets is reentered from the predicate finalization path and performs token transfers to an exitor controlled address
transferAssets executes IERC20(_token).transfer to an arbitrary user during processExits
transferAssets executes WETH.withdraw(_amountOrNFTId, _user) sending Ether to an arbitrary user
transferAssets executes IERC721.transferFrom to an arbitrary user which can trigger receiver callbacks
an ERC721 safe transfer into DepositManager invokes onERC721Received, registering a deposit for the NFT contract address as msg.sender
an ERC223 style transfer invokes DepositManager.tokenFallback with msg.sender being the token contract
depositEther calls WETH(wethToken).deposit.value(msg.value)() on a registry supplied address
the payable fallback forwards plain Ether deposits to depositEther
depositERC20ForUser creates the deposit through _safeCreateDepositBlock
depositERC721ForUser creates the deposit through _safeCreateDepositBlock
depositEther credits the deposit through _safeCreateDepositBlock
onERC721Received credits the deposit through _safeCreateDepositBlock
tokenFallback credits the deposit through _safeCreateDepositBlock
_safeCreateDepositBlock delegates the actual bookkeeping to _createDepositBlock
_safeCreateDepositBlock obtains a deposit id from rootChain.updateDepositId(1)
depositBulk obtains a batched deposit id from rootChain.updateDepositId(_tokens.length)
_createDepositBlock calls stateSender.syncState on a registry supplied StateSender before finishing its own effects
stateSender.syncState is an external contract entry point that can reenter the deposit flow
_createDepositBlock stores block.timestamp (now) in the DepositBlock createdAt field, making deposit ages timestamp dependent
_createDepositBlock writes the deposit hash into the deposits mapping
depositBulk loops over user supplied tokens performing IERC20.transferFrom external calls
depositBulk loops over user supplied tokens performing IERC721.transferFrom external calls
depositBulk creates deposit blocks inside the loop
depositERC20ForUser pulls tokens with IERC20(_token).transferFrom before recording the deposit
updateChildChainAndStateSender reads registry child chain and state sender addresses
addExitToQueue uses msg.sender as the predicate identity checked by checkPredicateAndTokenMapping, caller controls predicate authorization
addInput stores msg.sender as the input predicate after an isPredicateAuthorized check
StateSender.register authorizes callers through isOwner() or registrations[receiver] == msg.sender
PriorityQueue.delMin is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender
PriorityQueue.insert is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender
WithdrawManager.updateExitPeriod is onlyOwner, msg.sender controls the challenge period
Ownable.transferOwnership is onlyOwner, msg.sender must equal _owner
RootChain.updateDepositId uses the onlyDepositManager modifier comparing msg.sender to the registry value
Registry.mapToken is onlyGovernance, msg.sender must be the governance contract
createExitQueue requires msg.sender == address(registry) before deploying a queue
processExits stops processing when exitableAt > block.timestamp, so finalization depends on miner controllable time
getExitableAt uses now to compute the exitable timestamp of an exit
deposit creation timestamps come from block.timestamp and feed later exitable-at calculations
delMin mutates currentSize with currentSize.sub(1) and heapList.length.sub(1)
_percUp performs index.div(2) and array swaps on heapList with unbounded indices
_percDown relies on _minChild index multiplication and heapList indexing
processExits reconstructs exitId with (exitableAt << 128) | exitId bit packing over untrusted queue data
_addExitToQueue packs exitId with exitId >> 128 and uint128(exitId) shifts when inserting into the queue
submitCheckpoint advances _nextHeaderBlock with _nextHeaderBlock.add(MAX_DEPOSITS)
getExitableAt computes createdAt + 2 * HALF_EXIT_PERIOD which can overflow uint256
updateDepositId adds to _blockDepositId and checks it against MAX_DEPOSITS
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), permanently removing onlyOwner privileges
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged _owner state variable
processExits removes the processed element via exitQueue.delMin()
processExits returns the bond with address(uint160(exitor)).send(BOND_AMOUNT) to the exit owner
an exitor contract receiving the MoreVP bond can reenter processExits
transferAssets queries registry for the weth token address before transferring assets
processExitsBatch loops processExits over the provided token list
getExitableAt mixes now with HALF_EXIT_PERIOD producing a timestamp dependent exit age
addExitToQueue validates predicate/token mapping then calls _addExitToQueue with msg.sender as predicate
addInput validates the exit then calls _addInput
_addInput writes the Input struct into exits[exitId].inputs[age]
_addExitToQueue creates the PlasmaExit record and sets ownerExits/isKnownExit guards
_addExitToQueue mints the exit NFT through exitNft.mint
_addExitToQueue resolves PriorityQueue(exitsQueues[_exitObject.token]) from the queue mapping
createExitQueue deploys a new PriorityQueue with the new operator
submitCheckpoint calls stakeManager.checkSignatures on a registry supplied external contract
addExitToQueue consults the registry for predicate type and root to child token mapping

normalization_plan.reason: exitor is an argument of addExitToQueue and carries the exit owner value into _addExitToQueue
childToken is only used inside addExitToQueue to validate registry.rootToChildToken
rootToken is only used inside addExitToQueue for predicate and token mapping checks
exitAmountOrTokenId is forwarded from addExitToQueue into the queue entry
isRegularExit is a boolean flag consumed by addExitToQueue
priority is a uint256 argument passed straight through addExitToQueue
exitId indexes exits[exitId] in challengeExit
inputId selects exits[exitId].inputs[inputId] in challengeExit
challengeData is forwarded verbatim to the external predicate verifyDeprecation call
adjudicatorPredicate is the externally called predicate contract address checked by the registry
_token selects exitsQueues[_token] inside processExits
data is decoded by verifyInclusion into the exit payload
offset is an index parameter of verifyInclusion used for payload slicing
verifyTxInclusion is the boolean branch selector in verifyInclusion
utxoOwner is stored into the Input struct by addInput
age is the mapping key exits[exitId].inputs[age] in addInput
token is stored into the Input struct by addInput
_tokens is the iterated token array of depositBulk
_amountOrTokens is the parallel amount array of depositBulk
_user is the credited deposit owner in depositBulk
_amount is compared to maxErc20Deposit and transferred in depositERC20ForUser
currentExit is the PlasmaExit whose predicate is invoked through the unsafe external call
exitQueue is the local PriorityQueue dereferenced from exitsQueues inside processExits
exitableAt is the local timestamp compared to block.timestamp inside processExits
_token is the externally called ERC20 contract in depositERC20ForUser
_user is the credited deposit owner passed into _safeCreateDepositBlock
exitor is read from exitNft.ownerOf and used as the recipient of the raw bond send
key is the ownerExits duplicate guard key computed inside _addExitToQueue
halfExitPeriod is the new value assigned to HALF_EXIT_PERIOD by updateExitPeriod
_rootToken is validated and mapped inside Registry.mapToken
